verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export or backup feature, no open export formats such as CSV, JSON or XML, and no migration-out path. The documented REST API and its OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export. Community praise for querying data over REST is the same building block, not a documented 'export everything and leave' capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
